visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with a dark ponytail, wearing a pink t-shirt and white overalls, walks through an outdoor parking lot at night. She holds a large bubble tea cup. She smiles broadly at the camera while walking past a black sedan. (2) The camera angle shifts downwards to focus on the concrete ground, where a large wet patch of spilled liquid and some scattered ice cubes are visible. The woman's white sneakers and overall legs are briefly in frame as she reacts to the spill. (3) The woman is seen bending over in the parking lot, picking up her plastic drink cup from the ground near the rear tire of a black car. She looks embarrassed but is laughing. A young girl in a white t-shirt and beige shorts stands nearby, holding her own drink and a plastic bag. (4) A screen-in-screen overlay appears, showing a vertical video of the same woman in a modern kitchen with dark cabinets. She is crouching on the floor next to several broken pieces of a yellow-fleshed watermelon. She holds a finger to her lips in a 'shhh' gesture, smiling guiltily. (5) Back in the parking lot, the woman stands and laughs heartily, holding the half-empty cup. The young girl looks at her with a mock-serious, playful expression while clutching her own beverage. The lighting is dominated by artificial yellow street lamps and car headlights.
